ac4c3b4a10aef757b0147bd614add2fea2afc7ee.summary: BlackBerry describes WhisperGate, a multi-stage wiper disguised as ransomware, reported as targeting Ukrainian government, non-profit and IT organisations. The post covers stages three and four: an obfuscated loader that tries to disable antivirus and remove Windows Defender, and a final payload that overwrites files with a fixed byte pattern. The report does not name the threat actor.

ac09612e4de92769cf7f0b0bbeb25cfb5f612668.summary: This is a user guide chapter for the CodeBuilder development environment. It covers its UNIX-style file systems (a native fast file system and a UNIX layer on Macintosh HFS), file names, permissions, time stamps, links, and root directory layout. It is product documentation, not a threat report, so no threat facts are recorded.

ac5e1ae9222a705f18b7ba216fa2fad095e0a9e6.summary: Elastic Security Labs article (published 2024-08-30) on Linux persistence mechanisms, the third part of a detection engineering series. It covers init systems (System V, Upstart), rc.local, message of the day, udev, package managers (APT, YUM, DNF), Git hooks and pager, process capabilities and system binary hijacking. For each it explains how the technique works, how to test it with the PANIX tool, and how to detect and hunt for it. The article is educational and aimed at defenders.

tools.q: PANIX is a Linux persistence tool that simplifies and customizes persistence
Researchers from AON recently discovered a malware called "sedexp" that achieves persistence using Udev rules

T1037 - boot or logon initialization scripts: Message of the Day (MOTD)

T1546 - event triggered execution: Git hooks
T1546 - event triggered execution: git pager

hedges: MITRE has no specific categories for System V or Upstart; the report says these are generally part of T1037.
MITRE has no technique dedicated to process capabilities; the report says the most logical technique to add it to would be T1548.
MITRE has no technique for the udev-based cron and systemd mechanisms; the most logical technique would be T1546.
For system binary hijacking, MITRE has no direct reference; the report says it probably fits T1554 best.
Timing limits detection: some events may be missed before they are ingested, so the report recommends threat hunting alongside detections.

ac19a28a330a89059e1e48bc2ec6f768c0ac1723.summary: Aqua Security researcher describes a months-long campaign abusing misconfigured open Docker Daemon API ports to launch an Ubuntu container that downloads the Kinsing Golang Linux malware. Kinsing disables security tooling, kills rival miners, persists via cron, spreads over SSH using harvested credentials, and finally runs a cryptominer called kdevtmpfsi. The report lists IOCs and defensive recommendations.
